title: FROM JTCC NIGHT SHIFTS TO ARTHUR ASHE STADIUM
text:

Frances Tiafoe’s story is the epitome of the immigrant hustle. His father, an immigrant from Sierra Leone, worked as the head of maintenance at the Junior Tennis Champions Center in Maryland. Frances and his brother slept on spare folding tables while practicing every spare minute of daylight.

In 40+ years of coaching Olympic champions and executive leaders, the greatest competitive advantage I have ever seen is hunger born from humble beginnings.

You cannot teach someone who was born on third base the grit of someone who had to build the ballpark.

Honor your roots. Use your background as your greatest fuel.
